The 2026 Brazilian Music Awards (), the 33rd annual ceremony, will be held at the Theatro Municipal in Rio de Janeiro on 10 June 2026, to recognize the Brazilian music of 2025. It will be second edition with naming rights from BTG Pactual. The ceremony will be broadcast on YouTube. Cazuza will be honored at the ceremony. The nominees were announced in March 2026. João Gomes and Luedji Luna led with four nominations each.
Nominees
The nominees were announced on 25 March 2026, at the BTG Pactual Hall in São Paulo, by Fábio Porchat. João Gomes and Luedji Luna received the most nominations with four each, followed by Baco Exu do Blues, BaianaSystem, Lenine, Mestrinho, Orquestra Malassombro and Xande de Pilares with three nominations each.
Winners will be listed first and highlighted in boldface.
